name: ProgressRadial
description: Circular progress with the value in the center, built from Progress: for a single headline percentage.

props.name: value
props.description: The progress, from 0 to max. Clamped. Ignored while indeterminate.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Progress is happening but its amount isn't known: a quarter arc spins. Emitted as data-indeterminate; aria-valuenow is left out.
props.a11y: No aria-valuenow, so assistive technology reports it as indeterminate.

props.name: size
props.description: The ring's diameter in px, written inline as --apui-_s. The value text scales with it.

props.name: thickness
props.description: The ring's stroke width in px.

props.name: color
props.description: The bar's color. Emitted as data-color.

props.name: label
props.description: A caption under the value, such as complete, which also names the progressbar (aria-labelledby). Without it, name the progressbar with aria-label.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The value in words, shown in the center and read as aria-valuetext. Without it, the center shows the percentage.

props.name: hideValue
props.description: Leaves the center empty, for small rings; the label still names the progressbar (aria-label).

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { value: '…', bar: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The progressbar (role=progressbar) with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow.

parts.name: svg
parts.description: The ring, rotated to start at the top and mirrored in RTL.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: The filled arc: its stroke-dashoffset is the value.

parts.name: value
parts.description: The value in the center: valueText, or the percentage.

requirements: Same semantics as Progress: role=progressbar with aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow (left out while indeterminate), named by its label or aria-label.
The ring fills in the reading direction: clockwise in LTR, counterclockwise in RTL.
The spin slows under reduced motion.
